name: concise
description: Concise output style, working rules, model notes and 24 engineering skills

commit_gate.title: Commit gate
commit_gate.description: Judges each git commit: did the session run a verify, run or code-review skill, or does the message carry a Verified: trailer. observe records the commits it would block, enforce blocks them and lets the third one in a session through, off does nothing.

wait_gate.title: Wait gate
wait_gate.description: Judges each foreground shell command: can it sleep or poll for longer than a minute, also inside ssh. observe records the commands it would block, enforce blocks them and lets the third one in a session through, off does nothing.

privacy_gate.title: Privacy gate
privacy_gate.description: Judges each git push and each gh pull request, issue or release text: does it carry a path under this computer's home folder, such as C:\Users\<account> or /home/<account>. enforce blocks it, observe records it, off does nothing.
